_note: The wound levels come from the booklet; the Wound Table itself does not
SEVERITY ORDER - please confirm. The booklet gives the Recovery bonus as
Gravely x3, Severely x5, Badly x8 per full round in convalescence. A
higher multiplier recovers faster, so Badly must be the MILDEST of the
three and Gravely the worst. That also fits 'If not KIA or Gravely
Wounded' (the second pistol shot) and 'Save Comrade: reduce wound 1
level'. It reads oddly in English, hence this note.
If the Wound Table has a milder level that causes no convalescence, add it
with severity below 'badly' and recoveryMultiplier null.
Table entries: 2D10 (1..100), +10 when a duel card was played 'To Wound',
so ranges may extend past 100. 'health' is the Health lost - a number, or
dice notation such as '1d10'. glory/experience/standingDelta are ignored
for duels ('Ignore S, G, E from Wound Table').
